translation.name: Las Escrituras en Ashéninka Ucayali del Sur del Perú

content: Antarikitapaaki Isaac, tee ikowichaatee. Ari ikaemakiri Esaú, reewari itomipaeni, ikantakiri: “¡Notomí!” Rakanakiri Esaú: “Iitaka paawa”
Ikantziri Isaac: “Notyomí, naaka antyashiparitakina, tema rooteentsi nokami.
Nokoyi piyaate pikentakitena tsimeri.
Ponkotsitenari, poshiniri ikantya nokoyiri naaka, pamakinari noyaari. Roojatzi nopasonkiwentantanakimiri tekira nokamanakiita.”
Kemimaetaka roori Rebeca, okemakiri Isaac ikantziriri Esaú. Riyaamintheetzi Esaú ramini tsimeri royaari ipaapate,
okantakiri itsipa otomi: “Nokemakiri pipaapate ikantakiri pirentzi Esaú, ikantziri:
‘Pikentakitena tsimeri ponkotsitenari, kameetheeni okine noyaari, aritaki nopasonkiwentakimi tekira nokamanakiita.’
Pikemijantero nokantemiri.
Piyaate poteeyi apite iryaani cabra, pamakinari, nonkotsitawakiniriita pipaapate okaatzira iñaamatapiintari rirori.
Eeroka aanakinirini rowawakya. Opoñaantyaari ipasonkiwentemi eeroka tekira ikamanakiita.”
Ikantanakiro Jacob riniro: “Witzintzira rini yeeyi, rooma naaka tekatsi nowitzi.
Ari riyotawakina ashitanari aririka ipampitawakina, ari ikenkithashiretakya notheenkashiretatziiri, aminaashiwaetya ipasonkiwentena tema osheki ikijimatanakina.”
Okantanakiri riniro: “Naakataki ikiji pipaapate. Pantero eeroka nokantakimiri naaka, pamakinari apite piratsi.”
Riyaatashitanakiri Jacob ipirapaeni, ramakiniro riniro. Onkotsitawakiri roori, owetsikakiniri jempe ikanta iñaamatapiintari Isaac.
Aakiro rooperori ithaari antarite otomi Esaú royiro ipankoki, okithaatakaakiri Jacob.
Okyaantakaakari imashi piratsi rakoki, eejatzi ikentsiki jempe tee otzimi iwitzi.
Opakiri pan eejatzi owanawontsi okaatzi onkotsitakiri.
Raakotanakiro Jacob ijeekakira ipaapate, ikantapaakiri: “¡Paawa!.” Rakanaki Isaac: “Iitaka notyomi.”
Ikantzi Jacob: “Naakataki Esaú, pantarite pitomi. Nomatakiro okaatzi pikantakinari. Pipiriinte, poyaa noyentani, pipasonkitakotena.”
Ikantzi Isaac: “¿Intsipaetema pikentakitzi tsimeri?” Ikantanaki Jacob: “Riitaki kantakaawori Tajorentsi pawa noñaantakari intsipaete.”
Ikantanaki Isaac: “Pipoki okaakiini nopampitawakimi, niyotantemiri eerokarika notyomi Esaú.”
Pokapaaki okaakiini Jacob ipampitawakiri ipaapate. Ikantzi Isaac: “Aripaantewaetaki iñaawaetzi Jacob, rooma rakojampi riiwaewitaka Esaú.”
Tee riyotawakiri, tema witzipako ikantaka ariwaewitaka rirentzi Esaú. Roojatzi ipasonkiwentantanakari.
Rapiitanakiri rojampitziri, ikantziri: “¿Eerokama notyomi Esaú?” Ikantzi Jacob: “Jeen, naakataki Esaú.”

Ikantanakiri ipaapate: “¡Notyomí! Poyiitenari piyentane nowawakyaata, roojatzi nopasonkiwentemi.” Royiitakiniri owanawontsi ipaapate. Ramakiniri eejatzi imiri. Rowawakawo Isaac rirakiro imiri eejatzi.
Roojatzi ikantantanakariri: “Pipoke okaakiini notyomi, pontsirokena.”
Ikanta rontsirokapaakari Jacob ipaapate, ikemaenkatawakiro Isaac iithaari. Ipasonkitakotakari, ikantaki iñaanatziri:

content.text: Riima ikaate kimoshirewentakimini eeroka, imaeteeri eejatzi rirori.

content: Ikaatakiro Isaac ipasonkitakotakari itomi Jacob. Roo ishitowanakitziini Jacob ijeekira ipaapate, areetapaaka Esaú riyaatzira raamawenta.
Ronkotsitaki eejatzi owanawontsi, ramakiniri ipaapate, ikantapaakiri: “Pipiriinte pawa, poyaa tsimeri ikentakiri pitomi, pipasonkitakotena.”
Ari rojampitanakiri Isaac, ikantanakiri: “¿Jempe pitaka eeroka?” Ikantanaki rirori: “Naakataki Esaú, pantarite pitomi.”

Iyokitzi ikantanaka Isaac, riraashirenkanaka iñaawaetanaki, ikantanaki: “¿Iitakama pokaentsiri amakinariri itsimerite, nowawakari tekira pareetapaakaata eeroka? Nopasonkitakotakirira, tajonkawentaarewo rinanaki rirori.”
Ikanta ikemawakiro Esaú ikantakiriri ipaapate, okatsitzimotanakiri, antawoete riraawaetanaka, ikantanaki: “Pipasonkitakotzitena eejatzi naaka, ashitanari.”
Ikantanaki Isaac: ‘Pirentzira amatawitakinari, nopasonkitakotzimaetakari rirori, tema eerokawitaka nopasonkitakotemi.”
Rakanaki Esaú: “Tema iitaha Jacob, apite ramatawitakina. Retakawo raapithatakinawo neewatantari notzimaki, raapithatzitakinawo pipasonkiwentenami nimaeka. ¿Eeroma omataa pipasonkiwentawaena naaka?”

Ikantanaki Isaac: “Nowakirira pirentzi Jacob reewateemi eeroka, riitaki omperateeyaarini pisheninkathoripaeni, noshekyahaeniri iwankiri, ari oshiyawo eejatzi imiri. ¿Jempema nokanteemika eeroka notyomi?”
Eekiro ikantanakitzi Esaú: “¿Tema okameethatzi pipasonkitakotzitena naaka, ashitanari? Pipasonkitakotzitena eejatzi naaka.” Rapiitaneero riraawaetanaa.
Ikantanaki Isaac:
Aripaete retanakawo Esaú ikijaneentziri rirentzi Jacob, ipasonkitakotakirira ashitariri. Ikantashiretanaki: “Arika ikamaki intsipaete ashitanari, aripaete nompojeri yeeyi Jacob.”
Yotzimaetaka Rebeca oeta ikenkithashiretari Esaú, okaemakaantakiri Jacob, okantakiri: “Ikowatziira pirentzi rompojemi.
Pikemijantena notyomi nokantemiri. Piyaate inteena janta Harán-ki, ijeekira aarini Labán.
Ojamani pikantya pijeekawaete janta awijawaeta imashirenka pirentzi.
Ipeyakotawaeroota okaatzi pantakiri. Aritaki nokamanteemi pipiyanteeyaari. Tee nokoyi nopeyashityaari apite notyomipaeni.”
Okantakiri Rebeca oemi Isaac: “Osheki nojamashiryaakawo rishinto Het-ite iinatakari Esaú. Roojatzirika rayeri Jacob oshiyakawori iroka nampitawori Canaán-ki, okamethatzi nokamapithatero.”
